disclaimer: Published AP and supplier invoice benchmarks. Different populations, denominators and scope from protected supplier validation. Do not treat as local observed manual outcomes, comparable ROI or causal uplift.

entries.name: Reviewer touch time
entries.basis: published survey; full supplier invoice handling time, NOT active reviewer touch time
entries.source: Tipalti / Insight Avenue, From Manual to Modern

entries.name: Resolution time
entries.basis: published AP process cycle time; receipt-to-approval/processing, NOT this application's receipt-to-human-decision duration

entries.name: First-submission validation pass
entries.basis: proxy: APQC median of purchase-order-linked invoice LINE ITEMS matched first time; not whole-invoice first-pass validation

entries.name: Cases needing resubmission
entries.basis: proxy: AP invoice exceptions (missing information, errors or bottlenecks). Does NOT mean supplier resubmission.

entries.name: Evidence completeness
entries.basis: proxy: invoices linked to a purchase order, ONE form of supporting reference; not the percentage satisfying a complete required-evidence checklist.

entries.name: Cost per invoice
entries.unit: USD per fully processed AP invoice
entries.basis: published mean full accounts-payable invoice processing cost; not validation-only, not euros; includes labour, systems and overhead.

other_reference.limitation: Not equivalent to Ardent's 2024 average; separate year, sample and statistic.
